title: Bram and the Cover
author: Wren Vasquez
blurb: Kestrel Vane, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
